findings.problem: Witness count is charged only when popped. Each processed witness appends every cause to pending, including already scheduled or visited references. A dense DAG can grow the worklist to many repeated references and exceed the configured distinct-witness work bound before count refusal. Adding the unique-derived root can also grow roots past maxClosureWitnesses before admission.
findings.requiredEffect: Use bounded distinct event discovery: on first scheduling a required root or cause, check the remaining distinct witness capacity before inserting into any root/work/discovery set, and never queue a reference twice. Preserve all required roots for longest-path depth propagation even when one is another root's ancestor. Repeated roots/causes consume no additional event count. Preserve exact event/artifact byte charges, original unique custody, graph order/depth law, cover selection, immutable private output and all existing read/host/seam behavior.
